reviewMethod: Agent source inspection; no exploit PoCs or confirmed vulnerabilities. Selected cases, not a representative efficacy study.

excludedImpacts: incorrect data supplied by third party oracles, unless the report proves oracle manipulation or flash-loan manipulation accepted by scope
basic economic or governance attacks such as 51% attacks
depegging of an external stablecoin unless directly caused by a bug in Gearbox code
test files and configuration files unless explicitly stated otherwise
best practice recommendations and feature requests
dependencyConfigAssumptions: third-party oracle data is assumed correct unless an in-scope oracle manipulation path is proven
external stablecoin depegs are out of scope unless directly caused by a Gearbox code bug
third-party protocol behavior is out of scope unless Gearbox integration logic creates the impact
privilegedRoleAssumptions: governance, strategist, configurator, and other privileged addresses are trusted unless the report shows an additional modification to privileges or an attacker-reachable path
owner/admin-only paths are not bounty-actionable without a concrete privilege escalation or misattribution path

review.notes: Facade-gated transferFrom is not directly callable by an arbitrary EOA. Review facade caller authorization before deciding whether the payer can be attacker-controlled.
